data.long_description:
Discover this elegant 2-bedroom plus maid’s apartment in Crest Grande, Tower B, one of the most sought-after developments in Sobha Hartland I, MBR City. Spanning 1,323 sq. ft., this corner unit boasts a well-proportioned layout ideal for comfortable family living, enhanced by abundant natural light and Sobha’s renowned build quality.

Property Features:
- 2 Bedroom + Maid's room
- 4 Bathroom
- Size: 1330.84 sqft
- Unfurnished
- Private balcony
- Open-plan layout
- Built-in wardrobes
- Mid floor

Amenities:
- Well-equipped private gym
- Private swimming pool
- Restaurant and coffee shops
- Children's play area

The apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area, a contemporary kitchen, four bathrooms, a separate laundry room, and a spacious balcony with open views towards Hartland and Downtown. A dedicated maid’s room and one covered parking space add to the practicality and appeal of this exceptional home.

This peaceful community offers a comfortable lifestyle and is ideally located just 10 minutes from Downtown Dubai and 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport.
